name: Scenario
shortDescription: Game art generation. The pricing page we checked mentions a free plan.
longDescription: Scenario generates art aimed at games. The pricing crawl mentioned a free tier or free plan, plus starter language and no-credit-card wording. Paid samples in that crawl included $15, $45, and $75 per month — confirm them on the live page. We did not create an account.
bestFor: Game-specific image styles and asset sets
Art pipelines that want a free plan to start
notIdealFor: 3D mesh generation — see Meshy for that job
A hands-on generation test — we did not run one
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
